description: Send money to a Venmo user. Requires a recipient username, amount in USD, and a note describing the payment. Set confirm to false (default) for a preview, or true to actually send the money.

audience.description: Visibility of the transaction. Defaults to private.

confirm.description: If false (default), returns a preview only and does NOT send money. If true, actually sends the payment.

name: venmo_send_payment
